fixes.target: figure-1: Aftermath of a gas explosion, following damage to an underground gas service pipe
fixes.value: A photo of a large brick building that has partly collapsed, with a big pile of rubble, roof slates, timber and bricks spread across the grass in front. Standing parts of the building and bare trees are visible behind the rubble. There are no printed labels.
fixes.reason: The photo matches the caption about the aftermath of a gas explosion.
fixes.evidence: Image shows collapsed building and debris on grass.

fixes.target: figure-2: A safe system of work
fixes.value: A flow chart titled "A brief look at the process from referring to plans on site to the start of work near underground services", starting at "Planning the work". The steps are: "Refer to plans of underground services", "Survey the work area", then "Services detected and identified by trial holes"; if NO, "Further trial holes required" then "Services located?", where NO leads to "Contact service owner(s)" and YES leads to "Evidence of other services?"; a YES from the trial holes also leads to "Evidence of other services?". If YES, "Obtain more information and plans" loops back to "Refer to plans of underground services"; if NO, "Is work close to identified services?", where YES leads to "Carry out excavation using safe methods" and NO leads to "Use tools of choice".
fixes.reason: The flow chart is clear; the crop also includes four bullet points of body text above the chart.
fixes.evidence: All boxes and YES/NO arrows read from the image.

fixes.value: A colour photo of two workers in white hard hats and yellow high-visibility jackets working beside a hedge. One worker stands behind a blue machine with a control panel next to a long pipe or rod, and the other, partly out of view, holds a yellow hand tool over the ground. There are no printed labels in the photo.
fixes.reason: The photo is clear; the title "under a road" is not shown in the image and nothing in the photo shows a road.
fixes.evidence: Image shows two workers, hard hats, high-visibility jackets, a blue machine and a long pipe beside a hedge.

fixes.target: figure-3: Example of an electricity plan
fixes.value: A street map plan of underground electricity cables, with streets named Pembroke Street, Haven Street and Newport Street and house numbers such as 3, 12, 13, 21, 22, 23, 25, 26, 27 and 28. Cables are drawn as coloured lines, mostly orange, with a blue line across the middle. A box below the map gives Requested by, Company, Date Requested, Job Reference and Your Scheme/Reference (all XXXXXXXX), a table of Operating Voltage and Colour Code (132kV Black, 33kV Green, 22kV-25kV Yellow, 11kV Red, 6kV-6.6kV Blue, 1kV-6kV Violet, LV Orange, Unknown Voltage Brown), dig site symbols for Area, Line and Point, and scales on A4 paper of 1:1250 Area dig site, 1:500 Line dig site and 1:250 Point dig site.
fixes.reason: Figure 3 is captioned 'Example of an electricity plan'; the image shows a street map with coloured cable lines plus a key and notes box with the printed text listed.
fixes.evidence: Caption 'Figure 3 Example of an electricity plan'; legend table of voltages and colours; street names Pembroke Street, Haven Street, Newport Street; scales 1:1250, 1:500, 1:250.

fixes.target: figure-4: Example of a plan of gas pipes
fixes.value: A street map plan of gas pipes, with a National Grid logo and a key at the bottom, showing streets such as Broadmark Road, Uxbridge Road, Hazlemere Road and Rochfords Gardens. Pipes are drawn as coloured lines, mostly red, with blue and orange dashed lines. The top reads 'WARNING! This area contains Gas Mains Operating at High Pressure (in excess of 7 bar) and intermediate Pressure (between 2 and 7 bar)' and gives the Plant Protection team number 0800 688 588. The bottom box gives SCALE 1:1250, USER ID Xxxxxx Xxxxxx, DATE 28/10/2014, EXTRACT DATE 28/10/2014, MAP REF XX0000 and CENTRE 499118,180437, with a key of LP MAINS, MP MAINS, IP MAINS, LHP MAINS, NHP MAINS and HISTORY MAINS and a note that the information should not be used beyond 28 days from the date of issue.
fixes.reason: Figure 4 is captioned 'Example of a plan of gas pipes'; the image shows an annotated street map with coloured pipe lines, a warning box and a key box with the printed text listed.
fixes.evidence: Caption 'Figure 4 Example of a plan of gas pipes'; warning text at top; scale, date and map reference box; national grid logo; mains key.
